pagebreak_rule: Map every source data-page-index to one TEI pb in source order; direct Page renders receive their page number from the exact Page title.
footnote_rule: Preserve each visible [n] marker as a TEI ref to its section-scoped note; omit only the MediaWiki backlink arrow and preserve note wording and inline markup.
transcription_rule: Do not modernize, correct, silently normalize, or infer wording. Preserve HTML text order, paragraphs, lists, tables, emphasis, references, and the retained printer mark.
rights_rule: Carry contributor attribution and CC BY-SA/GFDL terms separately from the 1915 edition's source-reported US public-domain status. Do not assert worldwide rights clearance.
